title: Work IQ: real-time Teams meeting and call transcripts through MCP
summary: The control paths, PowerShell calls, default state and consumption licensing are supported. The briefing correctly reports the difference between the roadmap targets and the documented access-setting date. One minor qualification is needed because Microsoft's setup guide and MCP overview describe tenant provisioning differently.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; controls[0].governs; Governance controls
claims.claim: The documented WorkIQ access setting governs real-time Teams meeting and call transcripts received by apps and agents through Work IQ.
claims.quote: Work IQ lets agents and apps, including ones your organization builds, receive the transcript of a Teams meeting or call while it's in progress. The Work IQ access setting controls whether they can.

claims.claim: Learn says Work IQ access takes effect on 14 November 2026.
claims.quote: Work IQ access takes effect on November 14, 2026.

claims.claim: An earlier roadmap item also describes Work IQ real-time Teams meeting transcripts for apps and agents.
claims.quote: 570651: "Enable applications and agents to access Microsoft Teams meeting transcripts in real time for assistance and insights." Created: 2026-10-19T23:15:15.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Organisations already receiving real-time Work IQ transcripts needed to enable access before 14 November 2026 to keep their apps working.
claims.quote: Work IQ access takes effect on November 14, 2026. If apps in your organization already receive real-time transcripts through Work IQ, turn on Work IQ access before that date to keep them working.

claims.claim: An app must act on behalf of a signed-in user to receive a real-time transcript.

claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" "transcript" "per-user" "per-meeting". Read Teams transcript API access and Work IQ MCP policy governance. Work IQ access is an organisation setting; no per-user or per-meeting version of that switch was found.

claims.claim: The existing user-scoped Transcription meeting policy controls whether transcription can run, rather than granting apps transcript access.
claims.quote: Transcription is both a per-organizer and per-user policy setting. For meetings and events to include transcripts, the organizer must have this setting turned on. The user who starts the recording or transcript must also have this setting turned on.

claims.claim: AI must be allowed in the meeting; when Allow AI in all meetings is off, no transcript is available regardless of Work IQ access.
claims.quote: | Off | Off or On | No transcript is available. |

claims.claim: Work IQ access is independent of the Microsoft Graph access toggle.
claims.quote: It's independent of Microsoft Graph access, and it's off by default.

claims.claim: EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess requires the latest Teams PowerShell module.
claims.quote: This parameter requires the latest version of the Teams PowerShell module.

claims.claim: The cited Teams transcript access page gives no full navigation path for per-app Entra permissions.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" "real-time transcripts" permissions MCP. Read the full Teams transcript API access page: it says to use a link to the Microsoft Entra admin center to manage each app's API permissions, without an Entra navigation path.

claims.claim: Learn separately documents tenant-level policy controls for Work IQ MCP.
claims.quote: In the initial release, Work IQ MCP provides tenant-level policy control. In the Microsoft 365 admin center, tenant administrators can turn Work IQ MCP policy on or off for the tenant.

claims.claim: The documentation does not explicitly map the Teams access setting or MCP policy controls to this planned MCP live-transcript route.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" "real-time transcripts" permissions MCP; "Work IQ" "real-time" "MCP" transcript tool 572674. Read Teams transcript API access, MCP policy governance and MCP tool reference; no explicit mapping to the planned live-transcript MCP route was found.

claims.claim: The roadmap names no specific permission or consent procedure for live transcript access through MCP, and that specific mapping remains undocumented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" "real-time transcripts" permissions MCP. Read roadmap 572674, Teams transcript API access and Work IQ API permissions reference. General Work IQ scopes are documented, but no live-transcript MCP scope mapping or consent procedure was found.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not described actions automatically triggered by the transcript feed itself.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" "real-time transcript" "actions" trigger workflow MCP. Read roadmap 572674, Teams transcript API access and MCP tool reference. They describe transcript delivery and separate agent tools, not automatic actions triggered by this feed.
